name: Benjamin Gliklich
current_role: Chief Executive Officer and Director, Element Solutions Inc (NYSE: ESI)
profile: Ben Gliklich has run specialty-chemicals group Element Solutions (MacDermid electronics/industrial chemistry) as CEO since January 2019, after serving as COO and EVP Operations & Strategy from 2014. Before that he was at growth PE firm General Atlantic and in Goldman Sachs investment banking. Princeton AB cum laude, Columbia MBA with distinction.
interesting_fact: Under Gliklich, ESI has pivoted toward semiconductor and electronics materials, including the 2026 completed acquisition of EFC Gases & Advanced Materials, a supplier of specialty gases to chipmakers.
deep_cut_fact: In 2026 he was elected to the board of the Global Electronics Association (formerly IPC), the electronics-manufacturing industry body, for a three-year term. Early in his career he was in Goldman Sachs' investment banking division before General Atlantic.

public_contacts.value: Collected Strategies (Scott Bisang / Ed Hammond), +1-212-379-2072, media contact on ESI releases

notes: Low public profile; few interviews. ESI is a supplier of chemistry for semiconductor/AI-server packaging, a natural data-center angle. Route via IR or Collected Strategies.

name: David Barr
current_role: Managing Director, Bessemer Investors; Director (Compensation Committee chair), TransDigm Group
profile: David A. Barr is a private-equity veteran of 37+ years: 11 years at Butler Capital, 17 years at Warburg Pincus (co-head of Industrial & Business Services, 60+ deals), and since 2018 Managing Director at family-owned Bessemer Investors. He has sat on 40+ boards, including TransDigm (2003-2011 and again since 2017), Aramark and Builders FirstSource.
interesting_fact: He has served on more than 40 private and public company boards over his career, and currently also sits on the boards of Mas Restaurant Group, RotoCo and Xanitos.
deep_cut_fact: A Wesleyan alumnus and Wesleyan trustee, he chairs the Finance Committee of Good Shepherd Services, a New York City social-services agency; outside work he enjoys biking and paddleboarding.
notes: Common name; identity confirmed via TransDigm board + Bessemer Investors bio. Best route is via Bessemer Investors (firm site) rather than TransDigm IR.

name: Eric P Hansotia
current_role: Chairman, President and CEO, AGCO Corporation; Director, The Toro Company
profile: Wisconsin native Eric Hansotia spent ~20 years at John Deere before joining AGCO in 2013, rising to COO and becoming Chairman, President & CEO in January 2021. He leads the Massey Ferguson/Fendt/Valtra maker's push into precision ag (PTx) and smart, digitally connected farm machinery. Holds UW-Madison BS/MS in mechanical engineering and a University of Iowa MBA.
interesting_fact: A trained mechanical engineer, he has steered AGCO toward precision agriculture and AI, saying 'Young farmers are thirsty for digital interaction with smart machines.'
deep_cut_fact: His ag roots go back to working on a local dairy farm as a youth and being active in 4-H and FFA: 'I've had farming in my blood for most of my life.'

public_contacts.value: rachel.potts@agcocorp.com (Rachel Potts, Chief Communications Officer, published media contact)

notes: Accessible, frequently interviewed at farm shows (e.g., Farm Progress 2026). Route via AGCO corporate communications.
